TABLE.NAME: local_delegateaccount
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores which real user can log in as which delegated account

FIELD.NAME: realuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the real user logging in

FIELD.NAME: delegateduserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the delegated account they can access

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the link was created

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the admin who created this assignment

KEY.NAME: realuserid
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the real user

KEY.NAME: delegateduserid
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the delegated user

KEY.NAME: usercreated
KEY.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the admin who created the record

INDEX.NAME: real_delegated_unique
INDEX.COMMENT: Prevents duplicate assignments between a real user and a delegated account
